<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₄H₈O₄ (neutral mass 120.0423 Da), giving a protonated mass of 121.0495 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value. No other heteroatoms are needed to fit the mass.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
